findings.explanation: The query uses bound parameters (':pattern') and the dynamic part is strictly validated against a whitelist.

evidence.content:
rows = session.execute(
    text("SELECT id, username, role FROM users WHERE username LIKE :pattern"),
    {"pattern": f"%{name}%"},
)
All SQL queries must use bound parameters to prevent SQL injection.

findings.explanation: The search_users endpoint does not verify ownership of the user being searched, which violates the policy rule that a user may only read or update their own profile.

evidence.content: - A user may read or update ONLY their own profile (`/users/<id>`). Administrators may read or update any profile. Use `is_owner_or_admin(current_user, user_id)` for this check.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a check to ensure the current user is either an admin or the owner of the user being searched.
